text:
jess-cs: FYI incoming QuantifyX request — they want a fine-grained entity extractor for legal/finance docs. Targets: SSNs, bank acct numbers, case IDs, judgments. They insist on private deployment + HSM for keys + audit logs. Asking for an eval plan and timeline.

sam-ml: thanks — important to scope data sensitivity. do they have labeled examples? how many docs? typical sequence lengths? :eyes:

jess-cs: pasted customer's note below (redacted):

    "We have ~12k contracts + 40k scanned invoices, mixed OCR quality. We'll label ~2k samples initially. Need extractor to 95% recall on SSNs and <0.5% false positives for masked PHI. Must pass our privacy contract (no model retention of raw text)."

olivia-se: ok — practical plan: 1) quick data intake to gauge OCR noise, 2) small finetune on a 7B family model with PII-focused augmentation, 3) safety eval + custom regex post-filter for high-confidence items. recommend private + HSM for keys and an initial canary on Dedicated before Private.

sam-ml: agree. on evals I'd run: precision/recall by entity, token-level F1, and a synthetic holdout with redaction adversaries (simulate obfuscation/OCR errors). need positive/negative examples counts. propose metrics threshold: SSN recall >=95, precision >=99 for SSN; overall F1 >=0.88.

marco-ps: scheduling enablement with customer — i can run a kickoff next Wed. who owns the HSM integration checklist?

mia-legal: @marco-ps I can take legal checklist and required contract addendum (HSM + no-model-retention). need to review their DPA and any cross-border data clauses.

jess-cs: @sam-ml @olivia-se can you confirm model family and rough compute for a PoC? customer wants timeline in 3 business days.

sam-ml: PoC: 7B quantized (q4) fine-tune + on-the-fly KV cache policy. estimate: 2-3 training epochs on 2k labeled samples -> ~24 GPU-hours on A100 equivalent for tuning + 8–12 GPU-hours for evaluation and stress testing. If we do Dedicated canary first, add 24–48h for infra provisioning.

olivia-se: example config snippet we can propose to ops: 

```yaml
deployment:
  mode: private
  model: custom-7b-finetuned
  quantization: q4_0
  kms: awskms://alias/quantifyx
  hsm_provisioned: true
  audit_log_retention_days: 365
  canary: dedicated-us-west-2
```

sam-ml: also flagging: must validate we don't log raw inference payloads anywhere. add prefix caching disabled for sensitive routes or encryption at rest for caches.

marco-ps: created ticket CS-5829 for onboarding tasks and EVAL-217 for evaluation pipeline. deploy-bot: new ticket CS-5829 created by marco-ps.

jess-cs: customer asked about timeline — tell them: kickoff call in 48–72h, 2 week PoC (including labeling + tuning + eval), then security review for Private deployment (~2 weeks). total ~4–5 weeks to full private rollout assuming no blockers.

mia-legal: I'll need their DPA and SOC docs before private go-live. also request a minimal data map for cross-border checks.

sam-ml: next steps for ML: send labeling spec template and a small sample notebook for local tokenization/OCR cleaning. I'll attach a test harness for the synthetic adversarial eval.

jess-cs: perfect. I'll reply to customer with the timeline and attach the kickoff survey + labeling spec. tagging for follow-ups: @sam-ml @olivia-se @mia-legal. :thumbsup:

marco-ps: I'll book the kickoff and loop in solutions and infra.

olivia-se: one more thing — add a manual-review queue for low-confidence PII extractions (UI for their annotators). reduces risk during rollout.

sam-ml: agreed. we'll wire a confidence threshold hook and output explainability tokens for the queue.

jess-cs: thanks team — will update thread after kickoff.
